messages.subject: Shiny renderPlotly using script...FAILED
parts:
Hello,

I am developing app using Shiny. I want to render ggplot into shiny renderPlotly using a script. here is the server.R.
output$plot1 <- renderPlot({
    source("script/plot1.R")
  })

But it doesn't work. But I if I copy the code from plot.R and paste it into the renderPlotly, it works. So is it possible to have scripts inside renderPlotly?

Many thanks.
M

messages.subject: Re: Shiny renderPlotly using script...FAILED

If Jiddu's suggestion does not work, you can also try adding:

source("script/plot1.R", local = TRUE)$value
